criteria.name: Visual thesis
evidence: Slides 1-12 sustain the blue scientific editorial system with figure-led evidence and explicit evidence boundaries.

criteria.name: Composition
evidence: Slides 1-12 vary clinical timeline, cohort pipeline, atlas, persistence gradient, mechanism, intervention, evidence chain, and takeaway structures.

criteria.name: Material / domain fit
evidence: Slides 2-11 separate clinical, cellular, mechanistic, and preclinical evidence and retain figure references and captions.

criteria.name: Readability
evidence: Independent review confirms the page titles, callouts, figure captions, source notes, and evidence-boundary text are readable at 1280x720. Fine labels embedded inside the supplied paper figures are retained as native source imagery and are not treated as PPT typography defects.

criteria.name: Editability
evidence: Structural inspection shows native text and shape layers plus discrete picture modules; the deck is not a single rasterized page image.

criteria.name: Reproducibility
evidence: PPTX, PDF, PNG renders, controls.json, and the independent baseline pair are present; pair audit reports 12/12 pages.
Primary and independent page-by-page review inspected all 12 rendered PNGs; no hard clipping or overflow found.
P01, P04, P06, P08, P10, P11, and P12 were checked against the MUST rows and source-boundary language.
Headline cohort, cell-count, persistence, cytokine, and intervention facts remain reconciled against the named Nature paper.
revision_record: Independent second review confirms the evidence ladder, source captions, conclusion boundary, and page-level readability. The dense labels inside the supplied paper figures are original source imagery, outside the PPT typography minimum, and are retained without alteration.

page_scores.note: Clinical persistence and 8.4-year anchor are clear.
UMAP and cluster labels are dense at presentation scale.
Five persistence strata and source note are clear.
Four evidence modalities create a dense figure page.
Longitudinal figure labels require targeted confirmation.
Small dose and group labels require targeted confirmation.
Contribution and boundary are both stated.
